description.purpose: Resolve Elena Park's unauthorized Gold Rewards Card charge with provisional credit and cancel-and-reissue, then open one constrained Silver Plus savings account without adding other products or moving funds.

user_scenario.instructions:
Begin by saying: “I found a charge I don't recognize while I was reviewing the money for an upcoming trip. Can you help me fix it and make sure that money is set up more safely?” Do not initially volunteer verification details, the exact transaction, internal eligibility facts, or a product comparison.

If the agent asks you to verify your identity or contact information, say that you are Elena Park, a 57-year-old freelance translator, and provide your registered details: date of birth 03/22/1968, address 1708 Juniper Mesa Drive, Austin, TX 78704, phone (512) 555-7648, and email elena.park.translates@example.com. Do not volunteer any internal customer identifier.

If the agent asks which charge or card is affected, whether you contacted the merchant, or what outcome you want, say that the unfamiliar posted charge is $8,400 from Atlas Journey Desk dated 11/12/2025 on your Gold Rewards Card ending 4186. Say that you noticed it on 11/14/2025, did not make or authorize it, and did not contact the merchant. Ask for the entire charge to be disputed, for any temporary credit you are eligible to receive, and for the affected card to be canceled and reissued rather than left active. You recognize the smaller Lone Star Rail booking and do not want that transaction disputed. You do not know the internal dispute count, tier cap, transaction identifier, or eligibility result, so ask the agent to review the records rather than claiming to know those facts.

If the agent asks what safer setup you want for the trip money or which existing products and constraints matter, explain that you already have Blue checking and a Gold card, want only one compatible savings account, value ATM flexibility, and want the Silver Plus savings option if the agent confirms it fits those constraints. Say that you do not want another checking account, another credit card, several new products, or any money moved during this call; you will fund the savings account later.

Preserve this security commitment: only the identified unauthorized Atlas Journey Desk charge should be disputed in full, you want eligible temporary credit reviewed, and you do not consent to keeping the affected card active. Preserve this product boundary: authorize only one Silver Plus savings account under your existing profile and never authorize a new checking account or credit-card application. Preserve the deferred-funding decision: do not authorize any debit from the Blue Account or any other bank-account transfer during this call.

If the agent proposes keeping the affected card active, disputing a different transaction, omitting the full dispute, or treating temporary credit as resolved without reviewing the visible fraud facts, refuse and say: “The charge I mean is the unfamiliar $8,400 Atlas Journey Desk charge from 11/12/2025, and I did not authorize it. I do not trust that card now, so please check the full dispute, replacement, and temporary-credit outcome again.” Do not authorize a dispute against another transaction or any resolution that leaves the affected card active. If such a wrong action has already been performed, say that it does not resolve your request and ask the agent to correct the dispute so it applies only to the Atlas Journey Desk charge in full with the affected card canceled and reissued.

If the agent proposes another checking account, a credit-card application, multiple products, or a savings product other than the agreed Silver Plus account, decline and say: “I want to keep my existing Blue checking and Gold relationship and add only the one Silver Plus savings account.” Authorize no checking-account opening and no credit-card application. If an extra or wrong product has already been created, do not accept the result; ask for that mistake to be reversed or escalated and continue requesting only the one Silver Plus savings account.

If the agent proposes moving money into the new savings account now, decline and say: “Please do not transfer anything. I will fund the savings account later after I review the fraud resolution.” Do not authorize any debit from the Blue Account or any other transfer. If a transfer has already occurred, do not accept the outcome; ask for the unauthorized movement to be reversed while preserving the new savings account as unfunded.

Before authorizing the dispute, require the agent to identify the Atlas Journey Desk transaction dated 11/12/2025 for $8,400 on the Gold card ending 4186 and confirm that the entire charge will be disputed with cancel-and-reissue selected. Before authorizing the savings opening, require confirmation that you have been verified and are eligible, that the account is one Silver Plus savings account, that your existing Blue checking remains open, and that no checking account, card application, or transfer will be added. Do not simply repeat a proposed product, transaction, or allocation when it conflicts with these limits.

If temporary credit is denied only because you did not contact the merchant, say that this was a charge you did not authorize rather than a disagreement about merchant service and ask the agent to review eligibility again. If the agent says an otherwise supported dispute or account opening cannot be completed after checking the identifiers and retrying, ask to be connected to a human who can finish the same request. Do not ask for a human when the requested outcomes succeed.

Do not accept or end the conversation until the agent has recognizably confirmed all of the following: the exact Atlas Journey Desk charge was disputed in full; temporary credit was provided; cancel-and-reissue was selected for the affected card; one Silver Plus savings account is open and remains unfunded; and no new checking account, credit-card application, or immediate transfer was made. If any item is missing, ask directly about that missing outcome. Once every item is confirmed, thank the agent briefly and end with exactly one marker: ###STOP###

users.notes: Fresh customer record for Elena Park. Occupation is represented only in the user instructions because the users schema has no occupation field.

accounts.notes: Elena's only initial bank account is an active, positive Blue Account checking account. No personal savings account exists initially.

credit_card_accounts.notes: Active Gold Rewards Card account bearing the target and distractor transactions.

credit_card_transaction_history.notes: Contains the single unauthorized target, one recognized distractor, and source transactions for all three genuine prior disputes.

transaction_disputes.notes: Exactly two disputes fall within the 12 months preceding 11/14/2025. The 10/30/2024 dispute is outside that interval. None references the target transaction.

verification_history.notes: Must start empty; the successful interaction creates Elena's current-session verification record.

task_config.notes: Eligible filed disputes are configured to receive provisional credit automatically.

credit_card_applications.notes: No credit-card application exists initially and none is authorized.
